description: Startup intelligence for founders 🚀 StartupDeckAI is a Founder Operating System that helps entrepreneurs validate ideas, understand their business, and make evidence-backed decisions. Connect payments, analytics, CRM, accounting, GitHub, cloud infrastructure, and more. StartupDeckAI unifies your data into a Business Knowledge Graph and lets you ask an AI Analyst questions about your company. Validate ideas, research markets and competitors, analyze revenue, benchmark performance, identify risks
